title: Choose the composition
question: Device Datasheet is locked. Pick the first-viewport structure. Comp B drew a GPU object: that object will not ship (no fake hardware). Type, plates, and the red INSTALL are what we build.

options.label: Green field + spec rail
options.thesis: The green field owns the thesis; a gold-ruled spec rail states HOST, NVIDIA, not bootable; INSTALL is the only red note.
options.viewport: Running head, green thesis plate, right spec table, grant rows, red INSTALL at the foot.
options.risk: The right rail can shrink into a sidebar widget if the green field is not actually two-thirds of the fold.

options.label: Step column + ratings table
options.thesis: A gold-lit step column makes install a sequence; the fold is one ratings table on green.
options.viewport: Left 1–6 steps (step 1: not bootable); right a green ratings table; cream foot with red INSTALL.
options.risk: Ignore the GPU object in the render. It is not in the build.

options.label: Cut plates
options.thesis: The page is stacked datasheet plates with vivid green gaps: thesis, grants, limits, then INSTALL.
options.viewport: Cream head, green thesis plate, cream grant plate, green limits plate, cream foot with red INSTALL.
options.risk: Gaps can collapse into ordinary section padding if they are not actually visible cuts.
